question: Which film won the Best Picture award at the 25th IIFA Awards in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Laapataa Ladies**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The International Indian Film Academy Awards (IIFA)** is an annual event celebrating excellence in the Indian film industry, commonly known as Bollywood.
 
• The 25th edition of the IIFA Awards was hosted in the year **2025**, marking a milestone for the prestigious awards.
 
• **"Laapataa Ladies"** won the coveted **Best Picture award** at the 25th IIFA Awards, showcasing its outstanding cinematic achievement and resonance with audiences and critics alike.
 
• The film garnered widespread acclaim for its unique storytelling, direction, and performances, making it a standout among its competitors.
 
• **Other nominees** in the Best Picture category included notable films like **Article 370, Stree 2,** and **Bhool Bhulaiyaa 3**, but "Laapataa Ladies" emerged victor
